design: Replay full H792 4x4 source factorial for each item in one batch. Capture each stage at both source positions and final token. Quantify I(a,b)=z_ab-z_a0-z_0b+z_00, compare with actual joint change and native magnitude. Trace only, no interaction-removal intervention.
predictions: First source cannot depend on the later source under causal masking.
Immediately after L1 replacements interactions vanish.

At layer2 query attention contributions from two altered sources should add, since query input is unchanged and attention has no softmax coupling. Normalization and/or subsequent MLP can create query interaction.
limitations: Stagewise magnitude is not causal mediation or importance. Different stages have different scales; ratios need actual joint-change denominators. Reused panel; source-position causality is an architectural audit.
